messages:
maria: Heads up — Tidecore sent the APAC rack manifest but on-site flagged a firmware mismatch on 2/8 nodes. Manifest still shows all units as 'ready' and the marketplace is still advertising capacity. Can we pause the listing and reassign reservations?
kevin: Which racks/serials? Can you paste the SNs?
maria: SNs from on-site: TC-AZ-3112, TC-AZ-3113 affected. They boot, but the firmware image is 2025-09-phi while our runtime requires 2026-01-stable. Ops says the nodes fail healthcheck when we load our kernel module.
ashley: Putting marketplace SKU tidecore-apac-gpu-48 into backorder now (will confirm in a sec).
ashley: deploy-bot: please trigger a SKU pause and remove advertised capacity for APAC so customers stop seeing availability.
deploy-bot: auto: marketplace SKU "tidecore-apac-gpu-48" set to backordered by ashley at 2026-03-21T10:25:12Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: Thanks. Which customer reservations are impacted if those two are removed?
maria: Affected reservations: AcmeApps (dedicated commit, SLA window tomorrow) and NimbusLabs (lower priority, flexible).
sam: Acme has a contractual SLA. If they miss the deployment window we need to offer remediation. I approve temporary reallocation and a credit — suggest 10% service credit for the missed SLA and priority on the next available nodes.
kevin: Tidecore account manager replied: RMA + firmware flash onsite, ETA 5-7 days. They can ship replacement blades faster but need cabinet swap (logistics). That won't meet Acme's window.
maria: Proposed mitigations: 1) Pull two preemptible nodes from the EU spare pool for Acme (temp mapping) 2) Offer Acme 10% credit + prioritized scheduling for permanent swap 3) Keep Nimbus on the waitlist / offer burst in 48-72h if available. Thoughts?
ashley: EU pool has spare capacity but needs a 2hr maintenance window to migrate. Ops confirmed they can do tonight at 22:00 UTC if approved.
kevin: Confirmed with infra — cabinet power and cooling ok for two extra nodes, but network re-cabling required. Would need on-site tech.
maria: I've emailed Tidecore asking for expedited cross-dock and an RMA manifest; asked for digital manifest and proof-of-flash before they ship.
sam: I'll draft the customer comms for Acme. Tone: transparent + remedial offer (10% credit + temp nodes). Send me the migration ETA once Ops confirms time.
kevin: Ops replied in PM: maintenance slot 22:00-00:00 UTC, on-call tech assigned. No expected downtime beyond node restart.
maria: OK locking in. Next steps I'm taking: 1) Pause marketplace (done) 2) Map Reservations: Acme -> EU-temp nodes 3) Open partner escalation ticket w/ Tidecore; request manifest + flash proof 4) Send customer comm to Acme + CC legal/finance. I'll post the ticket link when created.
sam: please include cost center for credits so finance can pre-approve.
maria: Will do. TL;DR: paused listing, reallocated temp nodes to avoid SLA breach, partner RMA in flight (5-7d), offering Acme 10% credit. Will update thread when Tidecore sends RMA manifest. :thumbsup:
kevin: Thanks all. If Tidecore pushes earlier ship, we can cancel the EU temp allocation. Keep Ops in the loop.
ashley: Noted — marketplace stays backordered until we get green from Ops + partner flash proof.
deploy-bot: auto: ticket #PART-5983 created by maria (partner escalation to Tidecore).
